title: cinnamomum estrellense
intro: Cinnamomum estrellense, commonly known as Star Anise or Chinese Star Anise, is a plant species in the family Lauraceae, native to China and Southeast Asia. The health benefits of Cinnamomum estrellense include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve nausea and vomiting, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which can help prevent the spread of infections. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and relax muscles. The bioactive constituents of Cinnamomum estrellense include eugenol, beta-pinene, and alpha-pinene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
